sources.label: RA 9514: Fire Code of the Philippines — Fire Detection and Alarm Systems
sources.description: Governs fire detection and alarm system requirements including smoke detectors, heat detectors, manual pull stations, and notification appliances by occupancy type.

sources.label: NFPA 72: National Fire Alarm and Signaling Code
sources.description: International standard referenced in Philippine practice for fire alarm system design: detector spacing, placement, and notification appliance requirements.

sources.label: PD 1096 RIRR 2004, Rule XII — Fire Protection System Standards
sources.description: General building code provisions requiring fire detection and alarm systems based on occupancy classification, building height, and floor area.
